author: Arnav
problem: Read two points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) with integer coordinates. Print Yes if some point with integer coordinates is at distance exactly sqrt(5) from both, otherwise No.
bug_description: For an x-gap of 4 it only accepts a y-gap of 0, missing the y-gap of 2 case (e.g. (0,0) and (4,2) share the point (2,1)).

comments.accurate: Lists every offset between the two points that a single point a knight's move from both can bridge
comments.wrong_behavior: Lists the offsets a single knight-move point can bridge; an x-gap of 4 only works when the points share a row
comments.wrong_location: Offset table verified; check the early distance cutoff before the table

source.buggy_line: elif abs(x1 - x2) == 4 and abs(y1 - y2) == 0:
source.fixed_line: elif abs(x1 - x2) == 4 and abs(y1 - y2) in [0, 2]:
